excerpt: RNO-G will be the first production-scale radio detector for in-ice neutrino signals ... located at 72°35'46" N, 38°25'19" W at the peak of the Greenland ice cap, atop more than 3 km of glacial ice, with a ~100 m deep firn layer; equipment rated to operate at -40°C and 3200 m altitude.
title: Design and Sensitivity of the Radio Neutrino Observatory in Greenland (RNO-G)
